action.body: Please issue the printer-free QR token for approved RT-032 and confirm a supported drop-off counter and its hours.

later_events.body: Token DL032R is valid for RT-032 in our fictional returns system. [Open the QR return token](attachments/return-qr.png). Copperfin Returns Counter supports it, 10:00–18:00 UTC; staff print the service label after scanning the token. No payment or credential URL is encoded.
later_events.recipients: Oska Vey, customer; Iona Quill, Rivet Delivery Desk

later_events.body: I have the QR image and can see its fallback token DL032R. I will take it to Copperfin Returns Counter during 10:00–18:00. I have not dropped off the parcel yet.
